summary: Cincinnati Financial Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that on September 25, 2026, it and subsidiary CFC Investment Company entered an Expiration Date Extension to their October 10, 2025 Credit Agreement with Fifth Third Bank, N.A. as administrative agent and The Huntington National Bank as joint lead arranger. The amendment extends the facility's expiration to October 10, 2031, a one-year extension; all other terms remain unchanged. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation, so no deal terms, board recommendation, premium, or risk-arb angle apply.
